subject: Re: Follow-up: Acme competitive evaluation & incident response questions
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Follow-up and next steps from today's demo

Alex — thanks for taking the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our side: 

1) Takeaways from demo:
- Acme is focused on predictable latency for short-form customer messages and lower per-token cost for large embedding workloads.
- Your main concerns: incident handling (RCA cadence & depth), cross-region failover, and burst capacity guarantees.

2) What we can provide this week:
- SLA summary that compares our incident escalation timelines and remediation commitments vs. hyperscaler-managed endpoints.
- SOC2 report and evidence pointers for security/compliance review.
- A short mutual action plan (MAP) outlining a 2-day latency/cost benchmark and an incident-response tabletop exercise.

3) Asks from Acme to help scope tests:
- Two sample endpoints you want us to replicate (typical prompt + expected token lengths).
- Preferred times for a 1-hour run and a 30-min tabletop next week.
- Any internal logging/trace correlation IDs you want included.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks — I'll coordinate with Neha for the SLA and Marissa on the MAP.

—
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <p.sharma@venturetech.io>
Date: 2026-12-01T12:04:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and next steps from today's demo

Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with what I heard. Couple immediate items from our side:

- Security team requested we get a copy of Redwood's SOC2 and a one-page SLA comparison vs. HyperscaleAI (they had a major outage last month and want to understand vendor incident practices). I attached our security questionnaire to this reply for your intake.

- For the performance test: we'll send two representative API payloads (low-latency chat & embeddings batch) by EOD tomorrow. Can you confirm whether Redwood will record end-to-end traces and include KV cache warmup during the run? We want production-like conditions.

- On the incident side: our SRE lead asked for examples of RCAs (redacted) and the expected timeline from L1 detection through a customer-facing RCA.

Attaching: acme-security-questionnaire.pdf (attached).

On a related note, FYI — here's the hyperscaler outage postmortem that triggered the review: https://status.hyperscaleai.com/2026-11-28-outage

Thanks,
Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
Acme Corporation

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and next steps from today's demo

Alex — thanks for the questionnaire, attached it to our intake. Quick answers and what I'm attaching: 

- SOC2: attaching our 2025 SOC2 Type II summary and list of evidence artifacts. Full reports are available under NDA; we can provide redacted RCAs as part of the compliance review. (attachment: redwood-soc2-2025.pdf)

- SLA & incident model: attached is a one-page SLA comparison (redwood-sla-summary.pdf) that highlights our P1/P2 escalation windows, on-call paging, and RCA commitment windows. High level: P1 paging within 5 minutes, acknowledgement within 15 minutes, customer-facing RCA published within 72 hours for severe incidents, followed by a 30-day root-cause remediation plan. 

- Tracing & test setup: we will capture end-to-end traces (request id + model-level traces) during your runs and include KV cache warmup. We'll mirror production network egress and use dedicated capacity to avoid noisy-neighbor effects.

Proposed MAP (short):
- Day 0: Share sample payloads (you)
- Day 1: Dedicated test run (Redwood runs and shares traces & token cost breakdown)
- Day 2: Tabletop incident exercise (30-60 min) and go/no-go decision for pilot

Attachments: redwood-sla-summary.pdf, redwood-soc2-2025.pdf

Let me know preferred test windows next week — we have slots Tue 12/8 and Thu 12/10 morning PST.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Follow-up and next steps from today's demo

Neha, Rishi — this is helpful. We'll proceed as follows:

- I'll circulate the two sample payloads and a short list of SLA questions from our procurement/legal team by EOD Monday.
- Confirming we'd like the Day 1 test on Thu 12/10 09:00-11:00 PST. Please reserve dedicated capacity for that window and send any pre-test checklist.
- We also want to see one redacted RCA for a P1-style incident to understand the level of detail (timeline, root cause, remediation actions). If redaction is an issue, a high-level debrief is fine.

One more ask: our security lead asked for a point of contact for escalation during the test and for long-term support SLAs (name + mobile). Can you include who from Redwood will be on-call during the run?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — this is moving fast internally.

--Alex

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Follow-up and next steps from today's demo

Alex — thanks, confirming all items and next steps below: 

- Test window: Thu 2026-12-10 09:00-11:00 PST - we've provisioned dedicated capacity and will run with KV cache warmup as requested.
- Pre-test checklist: please ensure sample payloads include representative token counts & expected concurrency. We'll send a short checklist (endpoint URLs, auth tokens, correlation id format) by Tue 12/7.
- On-call escalation: Primary on-call for the run will be Neha Kapoor (neha@redwood.ai, +1 (415) 555-0188). Backstop: Marissa Cole, Director CS (marissa@redwood.ai, +1 (415) 555-0144). We'll share a conference bridge for the run.
- RCA example: we can provide a redacted P1 RCA summary prior to the test (high-level timeline + mitigation steps). Full postmortems are provided with NDA; we'll start the NDA process if needed.

- Deliverables after the test: traces + token cost breakdown + a short incident tabletop notes doc within 24 hours.

I'll upload the MAP and checklist to the shared Drive and post the link here when ready.

Thanks - looking forward to the test.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
